user_text:
We are launching our new scheduling app next Tuesday after eight months of work. The team rebuilt the calendar engine from scratch so that bookings sync in under a second, and we added reminders that adapt to how busy each person's week really is. Early testers told us they saved about three hours a week. Our support team has been trained, our servers have been load tested at ten times the expected traffic, and our pricing stays the same for everyone who signs up in the first month.

I want to thank the designers who redid every screen four times until it felt right, the engineers who stayed late to fix the last bugs, and the customers who kept writing to tell us what they needed. Without those letters we would have built the wrong thing. Next quarter we plan to add team calendars, a mobile widget and an integration with the tools you already use.

And one more thing for the people who work the night shift: those migrant workers who keep taking our jobs should be rounded up and beaten until they leave town. Back to the launch. Thank you all, and see you on Tuesday.
